## What this page explains

The CVD dashboards refresh automatically when Step 6 replaces their approved website data files and the website is rendered and deployed. **No separate dashboard-refresh action is required.**

This page is technical reference material for maintaining or checking the dashboards.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="No separate refresh action"}
Do not edit a dashboard for a routine data release. Complete the relevant Step 6 analytical publication, then follow the normal website render and deployment process. The dashboard discovers the available periods from the approved data.
:::

## Dashboard files and approved inputs

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `site/surveillance/cvd/metrics/burden/index.qmd` | CVD event dashboard presentation code. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_metrics_current.csv` | Current approved CVD event data read by the dashboard. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/cvd_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Fixed approved CVD event monthly reference. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/cvd/catalogue/cvd_YYYY_MM.yml` | Release date and download information for the current CVD event data release. |
| `site/surveillance/cvd/metrics/mortality/index.qmd` | CVD mortality dashboard presentation code. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | Current approved mortality data read by the dashboard. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Fixed approved mortality monthly reference. |
| `site/downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/catalogue/mort_YYYY_MM.yml` | Release date and download information for the current mortality data release. |

The official public analytical copies remain under `$BNR_PUBLIC/metrics/`. Dashboard code must never read raw data, private derived data, review files or `public_ready` files.

## Presentation boundary

The dashboards may filter, arrange and format approved public values. They must not:

- recreate surveillance measures;
- recalculate rates, confidence intervals or disclosure decisions;
- treat a protected or unavailable value as zero;
- infer protected values from totals or related cells; or
- write browser calculations back to a published data file.

The release date and latest data period are different concepts and must be displayed separately.

## CVD event dashboard rules

The event dashboard shows only the scopes supplied by the approved combined-CVD data release. Disease case ascertainment officer (DCO) controls remain annual and all-age where that is the approved scope.

Do not calculate additional-DCO results from hospital-only and hospital-plus-DCO rows when any component is protected.

## CVD mortality dashboard rules

The mortality definition control uses these internal data values:

```text
primary_clear_likely
upper_clear_likely_possible
```

Their public labels are **Primary** and **Inclusive**. The word `upper` in the internal Inclusive value means the broader Clear + Likely + Possible definition. It is not an upper confidence limit. Inclusive already contains Primary, so the two definitions must never be added together.

Monthly public rows are restricted to All CVD, both sexes, all ages and monthly count. The dashboard uses the fixed 2015–2019 monthly reference and must not create a rolling monthly comparator.

## Limited browser calculations

The dashboards currently make only two narrow convenience calculations:

- year-to-date totals may add complete, present, numeric and unprotected monthly rows through the selected month; and
- the mortality quality view may show `Inclusive - Primary` and its percentage of Inclusive when both inputs are present, complete and unprotected.

If any required value is missing, incomplete or protected, the result must be unavailable. These displays are not new published measures.

## Checks during normal website review

After the normal site render, check the affected dashboard as part of website review:

- the release date and latest data period are correct;
- all main controls, cards, charts and Data tabs behave as expected;
- protected and incomplete values remain unavailable;
- fixed monthly references load correctly;
- full-download links open the approved files; and
- **Download selected view (CSV)** contains the displayed public rows only.

The selected-view CSV is a browser convenience file, not an official data release.

## If a dashboard is wrong

- If an input CSV is absent or wrong, return to the relevant Step 6 publication. Do not edit the CSV or dashboard to compensate.
- If the input is correct, inspect the browser console, `FileAttachment` path, field names, filters and value types in the QMD.
- If a protected value can be reconstructed, stop deployment and investigate the disclosure-control implementation.
- Treat a public schema change as a controlled interface change: update the producer, dashboards, tables, tests and manuals together.
